title: Google Assistant support: Can't discover home automation device
description: Learn how to troubleshoot and reconnect a smart home device and your Google Assistant.  Visit support.google.com/assistant for more troubleshooting tips.

asr.full_text: Hey Google, turn off the lamp in the bedroom. Sorry, something went wrong. When you're ready, give it another try. One of your smart devices stopped working with the Google Assistant? Allow us to shed some light on the issue in three easy steps. First, open the Google Home app. Tap the menu, then Home Control, and check to see if your smart device is listed. If it's not, tap the plus to add the device. Second, tap on the device to give it a new nickname. Choose something that's easy to say and remember. For example, lamp. Then assign it to a room, like the bedroom. Third, try re-syncing your devices. Hey Google, sync my devices. You got it, syncing devices. Now let's try this again. Hey Google, turn off the lamp in the bedroom. Works like a dream. If all else fails, try unlinking and relinking your smart home device. For more troubleshooting tips, click here for the Google Assistant Help Center article.
